games.name: Flex Your FPS
games.desc:
Welcome to Flex Your FPS!

This game is built to push the limits of your hardware.
Test your max FPS, compare your performance with players from all around the world, and see exactly what your device is capable of.

Flex Your FPS also includes a wide range of customization options to suit your needs, all tuned by someone who actually cares about performance. The environment is fully optimized for both graphics quality 10 and lower graphics settings, giving every type of player the best experience whether you prefer raw FPS or better visuals.

Whether you’re here to flex your setup or find out how far your hardware can go, you’re in the right place. Have fun and good luck showing off your FPS!

NOTE: Uncapped FPS requires modification of your game client's flags, which not every device supports. For the best experience, play on a computer!
